title: NEET-UG paper leak: Supreme Court advises meaningful continuity in NTA reforms, not Committee-hopping
description: The Centre has set up a ‘task force’ chaired by Nandan Nilekani for tech reforms to make the NTA leak-proof; the apex court asks what has been done so far to implement the recommendations of an earlier committee; reforms in the NTA should focus on building an ‘institutional memory’, the court says
